theIslamicCouncilOf: The Islamic Council of Norway (IRN) is an umbrella organisation for Muslim congregations in Norway. IRN is behind Bønnetid and provides the prayer times the app is built on.
theTimesComeFrom: The times come from the Felles bønnetid project, which unites the mosques in Norway around one shared standard for when the prayers begin. That way the app shows the same times your mosque uses.
aboutTheProjectBehind: About the project behind the times
